description: The CG heuristic gives CBS a lower bound on how much the sum of costs of a constraint-tree node must still rise. A conflict is *cardinal* when every cheapest path of both agents takes part in it, so each way of resolving it costs at least one more step. The heuristic builds the *conflict graph*: one vertex per agent and one edge per pair with a cardinal conflict. The agents whose costs rise must form a vertex cover of this graph, so the size of a minimum vertex cover is *admissible* (it never overestimates). `mapf-search` computes a safe lower bound on that size and uses it for the sum of costs only, as `CbsHeuristic::Cg`.

papers.authors: Ariel Felner, Jiaoyang Li, Eli Boyarski, Hang Ma, Liron Cohen, T. K. Satish Kumar, Sven Koenig
papers.title: Adding Heuristics to Conflict-Based Search for Multi-Agent Path Finding
papers.venue: International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling (ICAPS)

lineage.source: mapf-search, src/cbs/cardinal.rs: "Conflict classification by MDDs (Boyarski et al. 2015), which the CG heuristic (Felner et al. 2018) and conflict prioritization build on."
